title: __FULFILLER_RESULT__ — task: discover (protocol v2, rail)
description: What a vertical has to sell for the question asked — for rail, the journeys between two places on a date (input rail-search.v1). Each item is something a quote can price next: `ref` is the recipe's own opaque id and must find the same journey again. price_from is the cheapest fare for the whole party asked, a teaser — the quote sizes the escrow. An empty items array is an honest answer. count must equal items.length (enforced by the SDK validator and the Go runner; a JSON Schema cannot say it).

summary.description: Descriptive, for the buyer's agent. Rail: departs_at, arrives_at (local ISO, no zone), origin, destination (station names as the supplier shows them), changes, duration_min, operator.
